description: Defines the class TemplateInt, a PHP class extending TemplateRange, for handling integer field templates in SuiteCRM, including methods for HTML rendering, populating from POST data, field definition, and saving logic with auto-increment support.

classes.name: TemplateInt
classes.description: PHP class for integer field template with auto-increment and validation features in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the TemplateInt object, mapping vardefs.

methods.name: get_html_edit
methods.description: Returns HTML input element for editing the field.

methods.name: populateFromPost
methods.description: Populates object properties from POST data, handling auto_increment boolean conversion.

methods.name: get_field_def
methods.description: Generates and returns the field definition array, including validation and auto-increment logic.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the field configuration, updating auto-increment values in the database if applicable.
